intent: Reuse the existing CAP-0002/3/4/7 contracts to execute one fresh-PostgreSQL combined storage-semiconductor trajectory containing the original supplier-cut/recovery vintages and the newly grounded later vintages. The run will project Micron's current wafer-start reduction and Samsung Q3's scoped PC/mobile recovery observation as Reality, preserve the original three Judgments plus the July 2023 SK hynix NAND-reduction decision as a later Judgment, and evaluate the April 2023 Samsung recovery forecast only as an explicit related milestone. Judgment revision-context persistence is intentionally deferred to a subsequent CAP-0007 extension because the current trajectory schema does not yet compose CAP-0004's existing context executor.
rationale: All required semantics already exist: CAP-0002 grounds the six source fragments, CAP-0003 projects the two scoped Reality facts, CAP-0004 persists four immutable Judgments and evaluates a non-direct related milestone as indeterminate, and CAP-0007 composes those phases in one fresh database. The missing Judgment-context invocation is a separate composition gap and must not block the already-representable Reality/Judgment/Outcome trajectory or tempt a campaign-specific workaround.
